title: Easy, robust approximate message passing for planted spike models
summary: We present a simple and efficient algorithm for robust approximate message passing (AMP) in the spiked matrix setting. In particular, let $\varepsilon$ be a sufficiently small constant, and suppose that $X \in \mathbb R^{n \times n}$ is a Gaussian matrix with a planted rank-$1$ spike, and $E \in \mathbb R^{n \times n}$ is an adversarially chosen matrix supported on an $\varepsilon n \times \varepsilon n$ principal minor.
